# Any scope. Bayan is alive at the Yuan court and sits in the cabinet (the same test as Y4's oe_yv_bayan_in_power,
# written here so this line does not depend on the Y4 files).
oe_yw_bayan_in_power = {
    character:yua_bayan_merkid ?= { is_alive = yes owner ?= c:CHI in_cabinet = yes }
}
# Any scope. The Yuan has fallen. F6 (Y2): the Yuan's branch secretariats were dissolved (global var oe_yp_dissolved) or
# oe_yp_yuan_fallen holds (gen_yuan_y3.py).
oe_yw_yuan_fallen = {
    OR = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_dissolved oe_yp_yuan_fallen = yes }
}
# Country scope. A subject of the Yuan (CHI exists and is the overlord).
oe_yw_sub = {
    country_exists = c:CHI
    is_subject_of = c:CHI
}
# Country scope (interface). A registered prince of this line that is still a member: CHI's subject, the Yuan stands.
oe_yw_prince_active = {

    NOT = { has_variable = oe_yw_out }
    oe_yw_sub = yes
    oe_yw_yuan_fallen = no
}

oe_yw_far = {

}

        AND = { country_exists = c:SYG c:SYG = { oe_yw_prince_active = yes } }

# Any scope. CHI already got an event this month from Y4 (its CHI pulse ran before the scheduler), from Y1 (scheduler id
# 10 runs before this line; Y1's pick counts only if Y1 fired this month: its counter oe_dbg_n_y1 moved since our last
# round, because Y1 keeps its last pick after its schedule closes) or from another Yuan line (oe_yuan_ev_m).
# This line then sends nothing this month, not even an event at its window end.
oe_yw_yuan_busy = {
    OR = {
        AND = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { has_variable = oe_yv_pick var:oe_yv_pick > 0 has_variable = oe_yv_m var:oe_yv_m = global_var:oe_yw_m } }
        AND = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_m global_var:oe_y1_m = global_var:oe_yw_m has_global_variable = oe_y1_pick OR = { global_var:oe_y1_pick = 1 global_var:oe_y1_pick = 4 global_var:oe_y1_pick = 5 global_var:oe_y1_pick = 10 global_var:oe_y1_pick = 12 global_var:oe_y1_pick = 13 } has_global_variable = oe_dbg_n_y1 global_var:oe_dbg_n_y1 > oe_yw_y1n_seen }
        AND = { has_global_variable = oe_yuan_ev_m global_var:oe_yuan_ev_m = global_var:oe_yw_m }
    }
}

# Any scope. Event 1: open (inside its window, not at its end), due (end reached), lapse (dropped).
oe_yw_open_1 = {
    NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_st_1 }
    has_global_variable = oe_yw_m
    global_var:oe_yw_m >= 0
    global_var:oe_yw_m < 3
    oe_yw_can_1 = yes
}
oe_yw_due_1 = {
    NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_st_1 }
    has_global_variable = oe_yw_m
    global_var:oe_yw_m >= 3
    oe_yw_can_1 = yes
}
oe_yw_lapse_1 = {
    NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_st_1 }
    has_global_variable = oe_yw_m
    OR = {
        oe_yw_never_1 = yes
        AND = {
            global_var:oe_yw_m >= 3
            OR = {
                NOT = { oe_yw_can_1 = yes }
                global_var:oe_yw_m > oe_yw_cut_1
            }
        }
    }
}

            culture = culture:mongolian_culture
            AND = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { culture = culture:mongolian_culture } OR = { this = c:CHI is_subject_or_below_of = c:CHI } }
        AND = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_yuan OR = { this = global_var:oe_yp_yuan is_subject_or_below_of = global_var:oe_yp_yuan } }
        AND = { country_exists = c:YBN OR = { this = c:YBN is_subject_or_below_of = c:YBN } }
            AND = { country_exists = c:LNG OR = { this = c:LNG is_subject_or_below_of = c:LNG } }
        }
    }
}
# Any scope (phase 4, M3). Neither Lanzhou nor Suzhou (Gansu) is held by the Mongol/Yuan/YBN/LNG side.
oe_yw_hexi_cut_off = {
    location:lanzhou = { oe_yw_hexi_loc_ours = no }
    location:suzhou_gansu = { oe_yw_hexi_loc_ours = no }
}
# Any scope (phase 4, M3). A non-Mongol leader holds the Middle Kingdom (e.g. Ming).
oe_yw_new_son_of_heaven = {
    exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom
    exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom.leader_country
    international_organization:middle_kingdom.leader_country ?= {
        NOT = { culture = culture:mongolian_culture }
    }
}
# Any scope (phase 4, M3). Notice event oe_yw.9 can be shown.
oe_yw_can_9 = {
    country_exists = c:LNG
}
# Any scope (phase 4, M3). Dali petition event oe_yw.10 (1375-1390): Yuan fallen, CDL exists, non-Mongol Celestial leader,
# and either LNG is gone or CDL is independent/fighting and fighting/neighboring the new Celestial leader.
oe_yw_can_10 = {
    oe_yw_yuan_fallen = yes
    country_exists = c:CDL
    oe_yw_new_son_of_heaven = yes
    c:CDL = {
        NOT = { this = international_organization:middle_kingdom.leader_country }
        OR = {
            NOT = { country_exists = c:LNG }
            AND = {
                OR = {
                    is_subject = no
                    is_at_war_with = international_organization:middle_kingdom.leader_country
                }
                OR = {
                    is_at_war_with = international_organization:middle_kingdom.leader_country
                    is_neighbor_of = international_organization:middle_kingdom.leader_country
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
# Any scope (phase 4). Post-fall Yunnan/NW tail stays open through 1390.12 while LNG, CDL or YBN exists.
oe_yw_post_needed = {
    has_global_variable = oe_yw_m
    global_var:oe_yw_m <= 644
    OR = {
        country_exists = c:LNG
        country_exists = c:CDL
        country_exists = c:YBN
    }
}

# Any scope (phase 4, M8). Both Ganzhou (YGU seat) and Suzhou (Gansu) are no longer held by the Yuan side.
oe_yw_gansu_fallen = {
    location:ganzhou = { oe_yw_loc_ours = no }
    location:suzhou_gansu = { oe_yw_loc_ours = no }
}
# Any scope (phase 4, M8). Notice event oe_yw.11 can be shown.
oe_yw_can_11 = {
    country_exists = c:YBN
}
